summary: Accepted the exact 51-operation sealed candidate after independent source and chronology review. It removes unsupported personal intervals inherited from bare Tang dynasty labels, age sixteen, and undated deaths; preserves one-sided chronology for pre-923, early-reign, and post-942 sequences; corrects Tongguang first year to AD 923; and corrects Tang Tianfu to AD 901–904. It preserves source wording, event ownership, evidence units, and all non-temporal extraction content. Source-specific unresolved holds remain honest holds rather than invented dates.

sourceEvidence: s0002–s0004: Tang offices of Lu Zhi's forebears are source-attested but have no personal Western years.
reviewedChanges.reason: The candidate correctly replaces invented late-Tang activity ranges and their active hints with explicit source-specific undated holds.

sourceEvidence: s0006: 「年十六」 gives traditional age only.
s0008: 「丁母憂」 records mourning after a death but gives no calendar date.
s0135: 「李崧之母薨」 records the death without date language.
reviewedChanges.reason: The candidate removes borrowed intervals while retaining source-backed age, mourning, and death evidence as explicit undated attestations and research holds.

sourceEvidence: The cited Tongguang first-year context explicitly identifies the first regnal year.
reviewedChanges.reason: Tongguang first year is AD 923; replacing the whole-era AD 923–926 range with AD 923 correctly preserves the source's stated precision.

sourceEvidence: s0108: 「唐莊宗平河南」 provides the pre-pacification sequence.
s0109: 「明宗初」 is an early-reign phase.
s0136–s0139: Gaozu's death precedes the Lesser Emperor's disposition and ensuing death sequence.
s0143: 「梁貞明初」 and s0144: 「唐同光初」 are early-era phases.
reviewedChanges.reason: The candidate correctly replaces flattened point dates and invented lower endpoints with conservative one-sided on-or-before/on-or-after bounds, retaining the source text and not claiming a nonexistent endpoint.

sourceEvidence: s0179: 「唐天福中，隨計京師」 identifies Tang Tianfu, not Later Jin Tianfu.
reviewedChanges.reason: Tang Tianfu spans AD 901–904. The correction removes the decades-late Later Jin Tianfu AD 936–944 conflation and synchronizes the active hint.
